job.job_description:
Designing, coding, and debugging various NLP and Conversational AI-based software applications that involve python, related frameworks, tools, and other back-end applications.
Candidates with experience in building and developing chatbots / voicebots are preferred.
Designing, developing, and managing data structures and database management systems.
Building and optimizing NLP and Machine Learning algorithms.
Web content scrapping application design and development.
Testing and improving the performance of existing software applications.
Maintaining and upgrading existing software applications.
Recommending new technologies that can help increase productivity.
Investigating software-related bugs, troubleshooting, and making necessary corrections to ensure optimal software performance.
Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues
